DynISFAdjust.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for DynISFAdjust.

autosens_max.summary: Maximum autosens ratio. 1.2 = 20% more ISF (less insulin).
autosens_max.effect_high: Allows larger autosens sensitivity ratio = less insulin when sensitive

autosens_min.summary: Minimum autosens ratio. 0.7 = 30% less ISF (more insulin).
autosens_min.effect_high: Lower minimum = allows stronger ISF reduction when resistant

boost_activity_pct.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_pct.
boost_activity_pct.effect_high: More ISF during activity = less insulin = safer

boost_activity_shadow_enabled.summary: Enables/disables boost_shadow_enabled. Gate flag for Boost feature.
boost_activity_shadow_enabled.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_activity_steps_15.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_steps_15.

boost_activity_steps_30.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_steps_30.

boost_activity_steps_5.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_steps_5.

boost_activity_steps_60.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_steps_60.

boost_adjust_sensitivity.summary: When ON: adjusts ISF based on 24H/7D TDD ratio. Higher recent TDD → less ISF (more insulin needed), lower TDD → more ISF (less insulin).
boost_adjust_sensitivity.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_allow_all_bg_sources.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_anticip_history.summary: Serialized meal anticipation history for ML learning.

boost_autosens_when_no_tdd.summary: When ON and TDD data unavailable: falls back to standard autosens instead of profile ISF. Prevents aggressive dosing during data gaps.
boost_autosens_when_no_tdd.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_bolus_cap.summary: Boost meal bolus size (units). Cap for meal-related SMB delivery.
boost_bolus_cap.effect_high: Larger meal boluses allowed — faster post-meal correction

boost_cumulative_smb_cap_60min.summary: Maximum total SMB insulin (units) in a 60-minute window. Prevents stacking. Higher = more aggressive. 0 = no cap.
boost_cumulative_smb_cap_60min.effect_high: Higher 60-min cap = more SMB stacking allowed

boost_daily_step_history.summary: Serialized daily step history for activity trend analysis.

boost_dynisf_velocity.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_dynisf_velocity.

boost_health_connect_hr_enabled.summary: Enables Health Connect HR data ingestion.
boost_health_connect_hr_enabled.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_health_connect_poll_min.summary: Minutes between Health Connect data polls.

boost_hr_integration_enabled.summary: Enables Health Connect heart rate data for stress-based ISF adjustment.
boost_hr_integration_enabled.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_hr_max_bpm.summary: Maximum expected heart rate. Used to normalize HR stress signal.

boost_hr_resting_bpm.summary: Resting heart rate. HR above this = potential stress. Lower = more sensitive.

boost_hr_stress_detection.summary: When ON: elevated HR above resting → stress detection → increases ISF (less insulin needed during stress).
boost_hr_stress_detection.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_hr_window_minutes.summary: Lookback window for HR stress averaging (minutes).

boost_inactivity_pct.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_inpct.
boost_inactivity_pct.effect_high: More ISF during activity = less insulin = safer

boost_inactivity_steps.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_insteps.

boost_insulin_req_pct.summary: Insulin requirement scaling (%). Above 100% = Boost delivers more insulin. Below 100% = Boost is more conservative. Primary aggressiveness control.
boost_insulin_req_pct.effect_high: Boost delivers MORE insulin — reduces hypers faster, higher hypo risk

boost_intraday_step_bank.summary: Serialized intraday step bank for short-term activity tracking.

boost_isf_shadow_state.summary: Serialized ISF shadow state (V4.4.2 EMA diagnostic).

boost_max_iob.summary: Maximum IOB for Boost dosing. Replaces standard max IOB in Boost mode.
boost_max_iob.effect_high: More IOB allowed — more aggressive corrections

boost_meal_time_history.summary: Serialized meal time history for meal pattern learning.

boost_ml_ring_buffer.summary: Serialized ML feature ring buffer (6-position lookback).

boost_night_mode_auto_by_sleep.summary: When ON: night mode auto-activates based on sleep detection instead of fixed start/end times.
boost_night_mode_auto_by_sleep.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_night_mode_bg_offset.summary: BG offset during night mode (mg/dL). Lowers target for tighter control.

boost_night_mode_disable_with_cob.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_night_mode_disable_with_low_tt.summary: Disables night mode when low temp target is active.
boost_night_mode_disable_with_low_tt.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_night_mode_enabled.summary: Enables reduced insulin during configured night window.
boost_night_mode_enabled.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_percent_scale_factor.summary: Global ISF scaling percentage. 100% = neutral. >100% = more ISF = less aggressive. <100% = less ISF = more aggressive.
boost_percent_scale_factor.effect_high: Higher ISF = less insulin for same BG = more conservative

boost_post_exercise_min_duration.summary: Minimum exercise duration (min) to trigger recovery mode.

boost_post_exercise_recovery_enabled.summary: Enables reduced insulin for hours after exercise ends.
boost_post_exercise_recovery_enabled.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_post_exercise_recovery_hours.summary: Recovery duration (hours). ISF stays elevated this long post-exercise.

boost_post_exercise_recovery_scale.summary: Scale factor for recovery (0.0-1.0). Lower = stronger ISF boost = less insulin. 1.0 = no recovery adjustment.
boost_post_exercise_recovery_scale.effect_high: Higher ISF = less insulin for same BG = more conservative

boost_pre_sleep_lead_min.summary: Minutes before detected sleep onset to start pre-sleep insulin reduction.

boost_scale_value.summary: Global ISF scale factor. 1.0 = neutral. Direct multiplier on ISF.
boost_scale_value.effect_high: Higher ISF = less insulin for same BG = more conservative

boost_sleep_history.summary: Serialized sleep history for sleep pattern learning.

boost_sleep_hysteresis_min.summary: Minutes of sustained low activity before sleep state confirmed.

boost_sleep_in_hrs.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for boost_sleep_in_hrs.

boost_sleep_in_steps.summary: Maximum step count during sleep-in window. Default 50.

boost_use_tdd.summary: Main gate: enables TDD-based dynamic ISF instead of static profile ISF.
boost_use_tdd.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_v5_active_dosing.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_v5_aggression.summary: V5 meal model aggression (1.0 = neutral). Higher = more insulin during meals.

boost_v5_committed_cap_u.summary: V5 max bolus for COMMITTED meals (units). Cap for confirmed meal dosing.

boost_v5_composed_floor_active.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_v5_confirmed_cap_u.summary: V5 max bolus for CONFIRMED meals (units). Lower cap for less-certain meals.

boost_v5_hypo_caution.summary: V5 hypo caution (1.0 = neutral). Higher = more conservative near hypo thresholds.

boost_v5_primer_bolus_mode.summary: Boost meal bolus size (units). Cap for meal-related SMB delivery.
boost_v5_primer_bolus_mode.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_v5_primer_tbr_fallback.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_v5_velocity_budget_active.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_v6_pre_meal_lead_min.summary: Minutes before detected meal to start pre-meal dosing.

boost_v6_pre_meal_target.summary: Target BG for pre-meal window (mg/dL). Lower = more aggressive before meals.
boost_v6_pre_meal_target.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

boost_v6_pre_meal_target_mgdl.summary: Target BG for pre-meal window (mg/dL). Lower = more aggressive before meals.

boost_v7_residual_pools.summary: Stored state or configuration string for boost_v7_residual_pools.

boost_wake_hr_hysteresis_min.summary: Minutes of sustained HR elevation before wake confirmed.

carbsReqThreshold.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for carbsReqThreshold.

enableBoostPercentScale.summary: Global ISF scale factor. 1.0 = neutral. Direct multiplier on ISF.
enableBoostPercentScale.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

enableBoost_with_high_temptarget.summary: Enables/disables enableBoost_with_high_temptarget. Gate flag for Boost feature.
enableBoost_with_high_temptarget.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

enableCircadianISF.summary: Enables/disables enableCircadianISF. Gate flag for Boost feature.
enableCircadianISF.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

enableSMB_after_carbs.summary: Enables/disables enableSMB_after_carbs. Gate flag for Boost feature.
enableSMB_after_carbs.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

enableSMB_always.summary: Enables/disables enableSMB_always. Gate flag for Boost feature.
enableSMB_always.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

enableSMB_with_COB.summary: Enables/disables enableSMB_with_COB. Gate flag for Boost feature.
enableSMB_with_COB.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

enableSMB_with_high_temptarget.summary: Enables/disables enableSMB_with_high_temptarget. Gate flag for Boost feature.
enableSMB_with_high_temptarget.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

enableSMB_with_temptarget.summary: Enables/disables enableSMB_with_temptarget. Gate flag for Boost feature.
enableSMB_with_temptarget.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

high_temptarget_raises_sensitivity.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

low_temptarget_lowers_sensitivity.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

openapsama_current_basal_safety_multipli.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for current_basal_safety_multiplier.

openapsama_max_daily_safety_multiplier.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for max_daily_safety_multiplier.
openapsama_max_daily_safety_multiplier.effect_high: Higher daily multiplier = allows more total daily insulin

openapsma_max_basal.summary: Maximum temporary basal rate (U/h). Shared with all OpenAPS plugins.
openapsma_max_basal.effect_high: Higher max basal = more headroom for temporary basal increases

openapsmb_max_iob.summary: Maximum IOB for Boost dosing. Replaces standard max IOB in Boost mode.
openapsmb_max_iob.effect_high: More IOB allowed — more aggressive corrections

smbinterval.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for smbinterval.

smbmaxminutes.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for smbmaxminutes.

uamsmbmaxminutes.summary: Used in Boost algorithm for uamsmbmaxminutes.

use_dynamic_sensitivity.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

use_smb.summary: Master gate for SMB delivery. Must be ON for Boost SMBs.
use_smb.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs

use_uam.summary: Enables unannounced meal detection for automatic SMB dosing.
use_uam.effect_high: Feature is ON — associated functionality runs
